# Medical

This folder catalogs medical classification systems and frameworks used to stratify patients or categorize clinical data within the corpus. It currently contains the Montreal classification, an international framework utilized for the age-based stratification of patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) in the Danish IBD quality database (DANIBD) reports.

## Pages

- [[montreal|Montreal]] — An international framework used for the age-based stratification of IBD patients, cited in the DANIBD annual reports.
